display.title: Mowzie's Mobs: Ferrous Wroughtnaut
display.subtitle: Break the iron sentinel
description: Deep in an underground chamber sleeps the §7Ferrous Wroughtnaut§r — a silent
iron knight with a colossal axe. It blocks while it winds up; learn its
rhythm, dodge the swing, and punish the recovery.
§7The classic first Mowzie's duel — a real test of your Tier 1 loadout.
